judge_branches.name: exact
judge_branches.semantics: 计分规则文档行：四档权重声明（尺子的口径正文）

judge_branches.name: usable-suboptimal
judge_branches.semantics: 唯一权重旋钮（模块级常量）：judge -> 权重，未知 judge 回落 0.5

judge_branches.name: default_exact
judge_branches.semantics: 题面无 judge 字段时按 exact 计

judge_branches.name: wrong
judge_branches.semantics: judge 查表得权重；不在表的 judge 一律 0.5（不拒收）

judge_branches.name: top1_equality
judge_branches.rule: hit = (top1 in (None, 'NONE')) if expected is None else (top1 == expected)
judge_branches.semantics: 命中判据本体：期望 None 走 NONE 盲区判定，否则**标量相等**。喂 list 会静默全 miss（不报错）

judge_branches.name: aggregate_score
judge_branches.rule: score = round(hit_w / n * 100, 1) if n else 0.0
judge_branches.semantics: 分数=命中权重和/总条数；分母恒 n，与 expected 取值形态无关（故对多标签中性）

judge_branches.name: max_achievable
judge_branches.rule: max_achievable = round(total_w / n * 100, 1) if n else 0.0
judge_branches.semantics: 设计上限=权重和/条数；同样只由 judge 决定 ⇒ 多标签不改变它
